root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Frontend Generic Type Parameter, Impl Method Scoping & Arity Validation
root_causes.Description: Type checker and parser permit leaking generic type-param scopes across methods, omitted arity checks for functions stored as impl methods, and unvalidated type parameter bounds in non-function contexts.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Isolate generic type parameter scopes in parser/typecheck and enforce strict arity matching on impl method tables.
root_causes.Notes: Resolved in PR #1965 (commit 7abb364e). Enforced generic arity <= 1 on impl methods (FND-375). Regression tests added for FND-023, 026, 035, 372. FND-056 superseded by FA-02-014/#1646.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Frontend Pattern Matching & Tuple Destructuring Validation
root_causes.Description: Pattern matching in sm-front fails to reject unpromoted wildcard match patterns, leaves borrow captures unrecorded in LetTuple plans, and permits refutable tuple items in irrefutable let bindings.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Enforce refutability checking prior to LetTuple plan generation and recursively validate nested tuple quad literals.
root_causes.Notes: Affects 4 candidate findings. [Resolved in PR #1970 (commit 05613f9d) under Macro Issue #1966]

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Frontend Parser Grammar Conformance & Expression Position Handling
root_causes.Description: Parser conflates unreachable statements with invalid loop grammar, mishandles generic types inside array element signatures, and drops loop expressions in statement positions.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Disambiguate statement-level grammar rules and validate generic type parameters inside compound array type syntax.
root_causes.Notes: Affects 3 candidate findings. [Resolved in PR #1970 (commit 05613f9d) under Macro Issue #1966]

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Frontend Type Coercion, Effect Isolation & Semantic Invariant Guards
root_causes.Description: Front-end type checker fails to preserve fx effect coercion for block-expression tails, lacks effect isolation in call argument expressions, and allows dummy types instead of error markers.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Preserve effect coercion rules on block tails and enforce argument expression effect isolation in sm-front typecheck.
root_causes.Notes: Affects 16 candidate findings. [Resolved in PR #1970 (commit 05613f9d) under Macro Issue #1966]

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: IR Lowering Ownership & Borrow Event Transport Pipeline
root_causes.Description: IR lowering drops borrow events from tuple bindings in value blocks, omits ownership events in loop-expression statements, and prematurely emits OWN0 sections before transport is wired.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Complete ownership and borrow event emission in legacy_lowering.rs with proper section gating.
root_causes.Notes: Affects 15 candidate findings. [Resolved in PR #1970 (commit 05613f9d) under Macro Issue #1966]

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: IR Type Lowering, Sequence Equality & Intrinsic Shape Validation
root_causes.Description: IR lowering fails to reject equality comparisons across sequence-containing operand types and misses validation of Hello IR and QTruth intrinsic statement shapes.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Add operand type guards in IR lowering for sequence equality and validate intrinsic statement lowering shapes.
root_causes.Notes: Affects 4 candidate findings. [Resolved in PR #1970 (commit 05613f9d) under Macro Issue #1966]

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: VM Ownership Tracking & StoreVar Event Synchronization
root_causes.Description: Deterministic VM fails to treat OWN0 roots as global symbol IDs, skips pending write events before StoreVar matching, and falls back instead of failing closed on out-of-range ownership roots.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Synchronize VM ownership event processing with global symbol IDs and fail closed on invalid roots.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: VM Execution Engine, Host Effect Buffering & Observation Semantics
root_causes.Description: VM buffers all print events during unit run APIs, leaks internal construction invariants, and lacks observation verification for semantic locals and branch counter profiling.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Stream observation events, keep VM structs externally constructible, and profile verified effects through capability host.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Core Runtime API Snapshot, Alloc Boundaries & Verifier Specifications
root_causes.Description: Runtime core exhibits API snapshot drift, missing alloc-only vec imports in no_std configurations, and undocumented duplicate symbol rejection rules in verifier.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Lock public API snapshots, audit alloc boundaries across no_std targets, and synchronize verifier error specs.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: CLI Manifest Path Normalization, Project Root Sandboxing & Symlink Security
root_causes.Description: smc-cli manifest loader and project runner fail to reject escaped imports when no ancestor manifest exists, allow backslash traversal on Windows, and do not sandbox symlinked project entries.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Implement canonical path normalization, strict manifest root containment, and fail-closed symlink rejection in smc-cli.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: 7hell Compiler Diagnostic Pipeline & Blocker Resolution
root_causes.Description: Shared CLI dispatcher misroutes type check errors away from Type Hell, introduces self-cycles in VM stage blockers, and re-executes SemCode during successful 7hell qualification runs.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Correct 7hell stage diagnostic routing in src/bin/smc.rs, eliminate blocker self-cycles, and preserve single-pass execution.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Specialized Core Execution Arithmetic Safety, Backend Probing & Bitmask Primitives
root_causes.Description: Call argument index arithmetic in semantic-core-exec lacks overflow checks, semantic-core-backend repeatedly probes CPU features on the hot path, and ton618-core leaks alloc requirements in MaskIndexIter.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Add checked arithmetic for call indices, cache CPU backend detection at startup, and re-export zero-alloc mask iterators.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: PROMETHEUS Capability Gate Channel Validation & Audit Tamper-Resistance
root_causes.Description: Capability evaluator permits unknown host channels (stderr, sockets) to evaluate without explicit denial, and prom-audit permits constructing invalid observation events directly.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Enforce strict fail-closed pattern matching in observation capability and restrict observation event constructors.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: UI Native Windowing, Winit Platform Backends & Event Loop Safety
root_causes.Description: Native UI backend lacks explicit Linux window backend dependencies in Cargo.toml, invokes panic-prone event loop APIs, and permits non-main-thread event loop instantiation.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Configure explicit platform backends in Cargo.toml and guard event loop initialization with main-thread assertions.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: UI Runtime Session Lifecycle, State Transitions & Shell Player Authorization
root_causes.Description: prom-ui-runtime permits backward session-state transitions, drops loop-control return signals in event callbacks, and lacks Shell Player session authorization synchronization.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Enforce forward-only session state machine and synchronize Shell Player authorization contracts.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: UI Presentation, Renderer Trace Integration & AST Slot Bridge
root_causes.Description: UI renderer collides diagnostic item IDs, drops trace references in render nodes, drops AST handles in slot intents, and mishandles out-of-range layout coordinates.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Derive collision-free render IDs from AST structure, preserve trace fragments in render nodes, and bound layout coordinates.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: UI Interactive Demo Harness & Input Hit-Testing
root_causes.Description: prom-ui-demo fails to submit built DrawFrames in demo loops, hit-tests incorrect card bounding rectangles, and lacks keybinding gates for interactive controls.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Synchronize DrawFrame submission in demo event loop and align hit-testing geometry with drawn card coordinates.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Integration Test Suite Quality, Acceptance Assertions & Guard Robustness
root_causes.Description: Integration and acceptance tests rely on hardcoded path hashes, omit payload assertions in match fixtures, and fail open when legacy guard files cannot be read.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Make acceptance fixtures assert runtime evaluation results, eliminate hardcoded hash symbols, and make test guards fail-closed.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Golden Trace Determinism & Replay Equality Test Invariants
root_causes.Description: Compiler test framework compares instruction counts instead of full IR content hashes and skips VM-observed output hash validation during replay equality checks.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Update CTF trace tests to hash full serialized IR content and enforce exact VM output digest matching.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Project Model Multi-Module CLI Acceptance Assertions
root_causes.Description: PCC-9 project model acceptance tests drop negative assertions for absent output files on compilation failure and skip hidden fixture entries.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Restore missing failure-path assertions and ensure full multi-module fixture traversal in PCC-9 acceptance tests.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Test Suite Log Sanitization & Sensitive Data Redaction (CodeQL)
root_causes.Description: Integration test tests/hub_cli.rs prints cleartext session tokens and request URLs containing sensitive credentials to stdout during test failure logging.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Sanitize test diagnostic output and redact tokens/session IDs before printing to console logs.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Workspace Script Portability, Local CI Preflight & Harness Hygiene
root_causes.Description: Scripts scripts/local_ci.ps1 and admission_guard.ps1 ignore command exit codes in smoke loops, omit nested workbench workspaces from fmt gates, and fail on dirty worktree exit codes.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Add strict exit-code checking ($LASTEXITCODE) to all PowerShell CI scripts and enforce admission guard in preflight.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Language Specification & Quad Logic Formal Contract Alignment
root_causes.Description: Normative language specifications in docs/spec and docs/language have drifted: command lexicon includes non-canonical stdout tokens, Quad logic bit encoding tuples disagree, and Logos grammar mismatches parser.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Synchronize syntax.md, logos.md, foundation_stdlib_v0.md, and command lexicon with current executable behavior.
root_causes.Notes: Affects 23 candidate findings. [Resolved in PR #1970 (commit 05613f9d) under Macro Issue #1966]

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: VM Execution & Verifier Architecture Specification Alignment
root_causes.Description: docs/architecture and docs/roadmap documents assert that raw VM entrypoints are admitted without verification, misattribute diagnostic ownership, and list obsolete scalar opcode rankings.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Update VM architectural blueprints to model VerifiedSemCode as sole admitted execution path and correct opcode rankings.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: UI Architecture, Effect Envelopes & Shell Player Specification Alignment
root_causes.Description: UI effect envelopes, event models, and Shell Player contracts in docs/spec/ui contain ambiguous event_ids, unstated window title bounds, and permit skipping RunSemCode verification.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Mandate content digests for RunSemCode admission reuse, bound window payloads, and synchronize Shell Player state specs.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Compiler Stages & 7hell Diagnostic Stage Mapping Contract Alignment
root_causes.Description: Roadmap stage mapping documents (7hell_qualification_contract, pcc4_pcc9_stage_mapping) reference nonexistent fixtures, have overlapping result rules, and omit Lowering Hell.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Align 7hell qualification contracts with actual diagnostic stages and remove stale fixture references.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Roadmap Tracking, Feature Maturity Matrix & Release Statement Alignment
root_causes.Description: Feature maturity matrices, application completeness ledgers, and roadmap closeout documents claim unverified milestones as closed, contain stale commit SHAs, and retain absolute Windows paths.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Audit and reconcile all status matrices against origin/main evidence, replace local paths with repo links, and align release rows.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Automated Code Quality & Clippy Lints Left in Main
root_causes.Description: Historical automated review threads raised by Clippy (PR #1841, #1892, #1951) regarding unused loop indexing and markdown doc list indentations.
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Resolved in subsequent cleanup PRs. Main workspace enforces cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings.

root_causes.Root_Cause_Title: Retired Experiments, Out-of-Tree Tooling & Legacy Metadata
root_causes.Description: Historical review comments on retired exploratory contours (experiments/ui-shell-kit, mission-control, legacy root markdown files).
root_causes.Remediation_Strategy: Resolved or obsolete due to architectural retirement of experimental contours.
